full_judgment: 2. The opposite party as plaintiff filed thee aforesaid money suit on 25.7.90 for a decree of Taka 30,000,00/- (Thirty lac) against the defendant. That the short facts of the case are to the effect that the plaintiff married the defendant on 1.1.82 and a son was born out of the said wedlock. That on 20.2.85 the defendant took a loan of Taka 25,000/- and purchased 2 ½  kathas of land in her name and subsequently a loan of Taka 7,24,000/- was sanctioned to her by the House Building Finance Corporation on 13.6.87 and before the sanction of the said amount, the plaintiff gave loan of Tk. 5,00,000/- (five lac) to defendant for starting construction on the said land. The plaintiff sent Taka 14,00,000/- to defendant from Dubai for construction purpose and the defendant also took loan of Tk. 5,00,000/- (five lacs) from the friends of the plaintiff and subsequently plaintiff repaid the said amount of loan and in this way the plaintiff paid Tk. 25,00,000/- to the defendant. The further case of the plaintiff is that the defendant also purchased Gold, Television, Freeze, V.C.R and furniture worth of Tk. 5, 00,000/- (five lac) and those are in possession of the defendant and by the end of 1989, the plaintiff came to know that taking advantage of-the absence the plaintiff from Bangladesh, the defendant has been mixing with other men in objectionable way and upon hearing of the said news he came to Dhaka on 26.2.90 and found that the defendant has been living with one Harun-Ur-Rashid and since the defendant is not living with the plaintiff as his wife, the plaintiff has been compelled to file the instant suit for realising said amount from defendant, and hence the plaintiff filed the suit for a decree of Tk. 30,00,000/- (thirty lac) against the defendant petitioner.
